title: AMC 8 Practice: Area of a Slid Triangle — How Much Sticks Out?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on the area of a shaded region when a right triangle slides, solved as whole minus overlap and with a clever strip. (Level 4 of 5)
A triangle gets copied and slid 4 to the right. How much of the copy sticks out?
Vantee shows two ways to solve it: whole minus overlap, and a clever left-over strip.
Then try a new slide yourself!
